title: Redis Cache
subtitle: Allocates an isolated (per-domain) Redis object cache to this domain — WordPress and dynamic apps reduce database load and speed up. Other sites cannot access this cache.
wp_connected_msg: Redis cache enabled and {{count}} WordPress installation(s) auto-connected — no further action required.
no_wp_msg: Redis cache enabled. For non-WordPress apps, use the credentials below.
confirm_disable: Disable Redis cache? The ACL user for this domain will be removed.
inactive_card_title: Redis cache is disabled for this domain.
inactive_card_desc: When you enable it, an isolated ACL user and connection info are created.
